requested_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: why can we not find the optimal partition; can we separate signals we filter by averaging from signals we fuse; can the clustering be learned from other answers
question: What is the exhaustive ceiling over ALL block-equal partitions of the 11-channel step bank on PRMBench, where do our label-free rules sit in that ranking, and does the best profile transfer across source-group folds?
algebraic_fact_that_makes_this_exhaustiv: Under block-equal the weight is w_j = 1/(K*|g_j|), so the fused score depends ONLY on the size of each channel's group, never on which channels share a group. The 678,570 set partitions of 11 channels collapse to 237,019 distinct weight vectors, which is enumerable. Asserted in the runner.

exploratory_result_being_verified.source: scratchpad partition_ceiling.py, 2026-09-24, two independent runs agreeing to the 4th decimal
exploratory_result_being_verified.best_size_profile: sizes [8,2,1]: energy_level alone (weight 1/3), chosen_surprisal + bocpd_p0 (1/6 each), the remaining eight (1/24 each)
exploratory_result_being_verified.equal: 0.7496, rank 80,100 of 237,019 (34% of profiles beat it)
exploratory_result_being_verified.leave_one_fold_out: the SAME [8,2,1] profile is selected in all five folds; held-out AUCs .7645 .7700 .7685 .7890 .7804, mean .7745 vs equal .7495
exploratory_result_being_verified.random_profile_reference: median profile 0.7455, i.e. a uniformly random profile is BELOW equal

what_this_run_adds: the exploratory selection used four folds; this run uses the project's 3 fit / 1 calibration / 1 evaluation split, adds PRMScore and ProcessBench, adds a single-channel reference and a shuffled-label selection null, and attaches paired bootstrap intervals
recipe_frozen: identical to bank20/indbank/declared_joint: Top10 step readout, answer-local z per column, bank11 channels in the frozen order; fusion code imported unchanged from .worktrees/depth-feature-fusion-v1
splits: source_groups_v2, five outer folds; eval fold k, calibration (k+1) mod 5 for the q80 PRMScore threshold only, SELECTION on the other three folds only

arms.lsml: label-free, CONT L-SML with the discovered partition (the Step 438 incumbent)
arms.energy_level_alone: label-free single channel; the strongest single stream (.7612) and the reference any weighting must beat
arms.profile_selected: LABEL-SELECTED: the size profile maximizing PRMBench within-AUC on the three fit folds, applied to the evaluation fold. Selection uses training-fold labels and is declared as such; it is not a label-free recipe
arms.profile_selected_shuffled_null: same selection after shuffling step labels WITHIN each fit-fold answer (seeds 0,1,2), then evaluated against the real labels of the evaluation fold; measures how much of the gain is selection noise over 237,019 candidates

secondary: the selected profile per fold and whether it is identical
the rank of every label-free arm in the exhaustive ranking
ProcessBench macro8 SLA as context only
predictions_frozen: P1 the same [8,2,1] profile is selected in all five folds under the 3-fold selection
P2 profile_selected beats equal with a Bonferroni interval excluding zero
P3 profile_selected beats the shuffled-label selection null with a Bonferroni interval excluding zero
P4 profile_selected - ct7 is positive but its Bonferroni interval includes zero
P5 profile_selected - energy_level_alone is between +0.008 and +0.018
labels: v3; used for the declared label-selected arm's selection inside training folds, and for evaluation
external_caveat: The parallel external line (docs/HANDOFF_FAMILY_TAIL_LSML_2026-09-24.md) established that SOURCE rank does not predict EXTERNAL rank: CT7 leads source PRMScore at 64.62 and is LAST externally on Hard2Verify at 37.75, while bank11 L-SML leads externally. A source-optimal weight profile is exactly the kind of object that may fail to transfer. Nothing here is promoted, and any transfer claim requires the external pipeline.
interpretation: This is a ceiling and a ranking, not a candidate. It answers three structural questions: how much any block-equal partition can be worth, where the label-free rules sit, and whether the optimum is stable enough for a rule to find it.
